levels.surface: ثابتا، مولى عمر بن عبد الرحمن

notes: The three first-level names are co-transmitters («قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا»): one level, one group.
The Companion عبد الله بن عمرو (2nd occurrence) speaks the Prophet's saying inside the story; the first occurrence is in the narrative and is not a link.
